items.title: 23.2.1 Carbonyl group ki banawat aur reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.2.1 with Quick Check 23.1 (answers need review), printed pages 100-101 (PDF 103-104).

blocks.text: Carbonyl group >C=O mein carbon aur oxygen dono sp² hybridized hain. Carbon oxygen atom se double bond se jura hai aur baqi do groups se single bonds se.

Carbonyl group polar hai, kyun ke oxygen zyada electronegative (electrons ko zyada kheenchne wala) hai, is liye us par partial negative charge (δ⁻) aata hai aur carbon par partial positive charge (δ⁺). Carbonyl group ki do banawati khoobiyan (structural features) aldehydes aur ketones ki chemistry aur properties tay karti hain:

items: δ⁺ charge ki wajah se carbonyl carbon electrophilic (electrons ka bhooka) hai, is liye nucleophiles us par hamla (attack) kar sakte hain.

Double bond addition reactions kar sakta hai kyun ke π bond aasani se toot jata hai. Saath hi group ki planar (hamwar, chapti) shakal carbonyl carbon ke ird gird bheer nahi hone deti, jis se addition reactions ko aur madad milti hai.

blocks.text: Aldehydes ketones se zyada reactive hain, is ki do wajahen hain. Pehli: ketone mein do alkyl groups ka electron dene wala (inductive) effect carbonyl carbon ka positive charge kam kar deta hai, is liye nucleophiles us par kam aasani se hamla karte hain. Doosri: ketone ke do alkyl groups hamla karne wale nucleophile ke raste mein aa jate hain. Ise steric hindrance (jagah ki rukawat) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Methanal H2C=O, aldehyde RHC=O aur ketone R2C=O aik qataar mein. Oopar teer baen taraf: 'Increasing reactivity towards nucleophiles'; neeche teer daen taraf: 'Increasing steric hindrance'.
blocks.caption: Nucleophiles ki taraf carbonyl compounds ki reactivity aur steric hindrance (bheer ki rukawat) (kitab ke PDF safha 104 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono teer ulti simt mein hain. Baen se daen (H₂C=O se R₂C=O tak) carbonyl carbon par bare alkyl groups barhte hain, is liye steric hindrance (bheer ki rukawat) barhti hai. Isi wajah se, aur alkyl groups ke electron dene wale (inductive) effect ki wajah se, reactivity ulti taraf yani daen se baen barhti hai: methanal sab se zyada reactive aur ketone sab se kam.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka naam '4-methylpentan-3-one' IUPAC ke lowest number rule ke khilaf hai. Chain us sire se number hoti hai jo C=O aur branch ke qareeb ho, is liye (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃ ka sahi naam 2-methylpentan-3-one hai.

blocks.prompt: a) In ke structures banayein: 2-methylbutanal, pentan-3-one, 3-methylbutenal aur '4-methylpentan-3-one'.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CHO; CH₃CH₂COCH₂CH₃; 3-methylbutenal ko 3-methylbut-2-enal, (CH₃)₂C=CHCHO, samjhein (agar kitab ka matlab 3-methylbutanal ho to (CH₃)₂CHCH₂CHO); (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃, jis ka durust IUPAC naam 2-methylpentan-3-one hai (chain us sire se number hoti hai jahan se kam number milein).

blocks.alt: Structural formulas: (i) 2-methylbutanal; (ii) pentan-3-one CH3-CH2-CO-CH2-CH3; (iii) 3-methylbut-2-enal (CH3)2C=CH-CHO, aur saath 3-methylbutanal (CH3)2CH-CH2-CHO agar kitab ka matlab butanal ho; (iv) (CH3)2CH-CO-CH2-CH3, carbons par neele number 1 se 5, sahi naam 2-methylpentan-3-one (kitab: 4-methylpentan-3-one).
blocks.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): 2-methylbutanal, pentan-3-one, 3-methylbut-2-enal (ya 3-methylbutanal) aur kitab ka '4-methylpentan-3-one', jo asal mein 2-methylpentan-3-one hai: C=O dono taraf se 3 par hai, is liye branch ko kam number (2) milna chahiye.
blocks.long_description: Pehle do structures 2-methylbutanal aur pentan-3-one hain. Teesre number par kitab ka '3-methylbutenal' hai, jise 3-methylbut-2-enal, (CH₃)₂C=CH–CHO, samjha gaya hai; us ke neeche 3-methylbutanal, (CH₃)₂CH–CH₂–CHO, bhi diya hai agar kitab ka matlab butanal ho. Aakhri structure (CH₃)₂CH–CO–CH₂–CH₃ hai: neele number baen se 1 se 5 tak hain, C=O carbon 3 par aur methyl branch carbon 2 par. Is liye sahi naam 2-methylpentan-3-one hai, kitab ka 4-methylpentan-3-one nahi.

blocks.prompt: b) In ke IUPAC naam batayein: C₆H₅–CHO, (CH₃)₃C–CHO aur (CH₃CH₂CH₂)₂C=O.
c) (CH₃)₃CCOCH₃, (CH₃)₃CCOC(CH₃)₃ aur (CH₃)₂CO ko nucleophilic attack ki taraf barhti reactivity ki tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: (CH₃)₃CCOC(CH₃)₃ < (CH₃)₃CCOCH₃ < (CH₃)₂CO. Carbonyl carbon par groups jitne bare, steric hindrance utni zyada aur reactivity utni kam.

items: C=O: carbon aur oxygen sp², group planar aur polar (C δ⁺, O δ⁻).
Electrophilic carbon aur aasani se tootne wala π bond: nucleophilic addition.
Aldehydes > ketones (inductive effect aur steric hindrance); methanal sab se zyada reactive.
